'''Yutrane-Trackata''' was the manufacturer of several mining vehicles and military tanks. It was based on the planet [[Aridus/Legends|Aridus]]. While the company was contracted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], several members were sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], and helped arrange Rebel raids to acquire tanks.
